label: Planned Treatment for Period 01 (N)
derivation: Placebo=0; Xanomeline Low Dose=54; Xanomeline High Dose=81; Screen Failure=missing

label: Actual Treatment for Period 01 (N)
derivation: Placebo=0; Xanomeline Low Dose=54; Xanomeline High Dose=81; Screen Failure=missing

label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
derivation: Earliest EX start date (EXSTDTC) with EXDOSE>0 or placebo; no date imputation

label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
derivation: Latest EX end date (EXENDTC) with EXDOSE>0 or placebo; no date imputation

label: Last Known Date on Treatment
derivation: TRTEDT if present; otherwise latest EX start date with EXDOSE>0 or placebo

label: Safety Population Flag
derivation: Y if any EX record with EXDOSE>0 or placebo; else N

label: End of Study Status
derivation: DS disposition event: COMPLETED; SCREEN FAILURE=missing; other=DISCONTINUED; none=ONGOING

label: End of Study Date
derivation: DS disposition event start date (DSSTDTC), excluding SCREEN FAILURE

label: Reason for Discontinuation from Study
derivation: DS.DSDECOD of disposition event when not COMPLETED or SCREEN FAILURE

label: Analysis Start Date
derivation: AESTDTC; missing day->1, missing month->January, not before TRTSDT if same month and year

label: Analysis Start Date Imputation Flag
derivation: D if day imputed; M if month and day imputed

label: Analysis End Date
derivation: AEENDTC; missing day->last day of month, missing month->December

label: Dermatologic Event Flag
derivation: Y if AEBODSYS=SKIN AND SUBCUTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS or AEDECOD starts with APPLICATION SITE

label: Parameter
derivation: v1.1 literal: TTDE=Tiempo hasta el primer EA dermatologico en tratamiento (dias); TTDE30=Tiempo hasta el primer EA dermatologico, ventana TEAE +30 dias (dias); TTDESOC=Tiempo hasta el primer EA de piel, solo SOC (dias); TTDEIMPL=Tiempo hasta el primer EA dermatologico, imputacion al ultimo dia (dias); TTDEEOS=Tiempo hasta el primer EA dermatologico, sin TRTEDT censura en EOSDT (dias)

label: Time to Event Origin Date for Subject
Analysis Date
derivation: Event date or censoring date per SAP section 4

label: Event or Censoring Description
derivation: v1.1: events = PRIMER EVENTO DERMATOLOGICO; censored = 'CENSURA: ' followed by CNSDTDSC

label: Censor Date Description
derivation: TRATAMIENTO COMPLETADO; INTERRUPCION POR EA; OTRA INTERRUPCION (missing if event)

label: Source Data
derivation: ADAE for events; ADSL for censoring

label: Source Variable
derivation: v1.1: events = ASTDT (ASTLDT for TTDEIMPL); censored = EOSDT if the censoring date came from EOSDT, otherwise TRTEDT if TRTEDT is present, otherwise LSTEXDT
